steps.content: The grotesque forms crumple at your feet, their final breaths whispering the broken dreams for DisCity before they dissolve into dust.
This promising name—Désir—finally reveals itself a deceptive deadfall that preys on the vulnerable human hearts. In this crafted mirage of an oasis, the illusion forevermore renews.
Silence settles over the alley as the scent of Mania fades. The truth has finally come to light, yet you remain rooted where you are.
[Juan]
First, built this town on a wasteland on the border with her merchant caravan, spreading rumors of a gateway to DisCity, luring in those desperate to Désir, those with no means or money.
[Liam] [Primrose]
Next, feeds the newcomers' dreams of DisCity with forged letters and lies; offers them jobs to cover their living expenses here, trapping them here.
[Alba]
And finally, makes up endless excuses to delay their leaves. Living costs mount, they have no choice but to stay.
You push through the tangled mass of withered plants at your feet, struggling to free yourself from their grasp.

Your real goal is to keep them here indefinitely. Perhaps "smuggler" doesn't fit—you've never actually sent anyone to DisCity. No wonder the Outland Affairs Bureau couldn't pin trafficking charges on you.

Their dreams unfulfilled, their resentment grows, festering into monsters in this Mania-infested wasteland of WhiteSands. And so, the tragic cycle continues, fueled by toxic flowers that numb the townsfolk...
Behind you, a pair of high heels crushes the withered vines, the delicate footsteps drawing closer. You know who that is. She's been there, following you, all along.
From the moment I set foot in Désir, you've been encouraging my every step, wanting me to uncover this town, uncover you. But a true villain wouldn't go to such lengths just to expose themselves.
I'd much prefer a fair partnership to being manipulated like a fool.
But partnership never builds without honesty.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: You're sharper than I gave you credit for. I thought you'd need another day to put it all together.
Despite your suspicion and provocation, Vautour Bleu doesn't display any hostility, her composure as unruffled as ever. She holds your wrist gently, then gestures forward.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: If you have more questions, follow that path to the edge of Désir, to see the most picturesque view in this town.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I'll be waiting for you there, little Chief.
[Town center]
Meanwhile, throughout the town, datura flowers begin to wither, their fragrance gradually dissipating.
Alba sits outside the diner, dazed and motionless, all her energy to dance drained. She forces a smile and mutters the same words over and over again.

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: Right, of course. I'm not in a rush... I get it. Just take some time.
As her compulsive muttering continues, black mist gathers behind her, the once-lush plants wilting as soon as they creep closer.

steps.speaker: Juan
steps.content: The hell is that?! Am I still drunk? Holy crap... watch out Alba!
Juan's holler snaps Alba from her stupor. She looks around cluelessly, only to find withered plants surrounding her, oblivious to the contamination she's just caused.
Whispers of despair begin to echo through every shadowy corner of the town.
The despairing monsters, long besieging Désir, are on the verge of breaking free from the town's illusory chains. As the peaceful facade begins to crack, Mania stirs once again.
